links.outcome: Readability of AI smoking cessation responses (Ateşman's Readability Index)
links.effect: Average readability score 54.90 (medium difficulty); authors conclude responses suit individuals with at least a high school education.
links.quote: The average readability score was 54.90 (medium difficulty) according to Atesman's Index.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, readability, and motivational interviewing quality of 10 publicly accessible AI chatbots responding to simulated patient smoking cessation questions, without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
